content:
Maya (Support): @Sam thanks for filing this. forwarding escalation — you said a small change to your template now breaks the summary output after today\'s rollout? can you paste the exact prompt + response you used?

Sam (Customer): Yup. Tried adding a trailing newline to the invoice prompt and half the summary disappears. worked yesterday. Happening on hosted API, model: redwood/rw-invoice-1.

Sam (Customer): Repro steps below — minimal: curl to /v1/completions with the template.
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/completions \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood/rw-invoice-1","input":"Summarize invoice:\n\nItems:\n- Service A: $100\n- Service B: $200\n\nNotes:\nPlease include total."}'
```

Sam (Customer): Response used to be full paragraph with totals; now it returns truncated sentence: "Total amount due is" and then stops. No 500, status 200. Token usage looks normal.

Maya (Support): thanks — curious if it\'s reproducible without the newline. can you paste two requests: with and without trailing newline?

Sam (Customer): Here: (1) without extra newline -> OK. (2) with trailing newline -> truncated.

Sam (Customer): With newline: ```json
{"model":"redwood/rw-invoice-1","input":"Summarize invoice:\n\nItems:\n- Service A: $100\n- Service B: $200\n\nNotes:\nPlease include total.\n"}
```

Sam (Customer): Response: ```json
{"id":"resp_123","status":200,"output":"Total amount due is"}"
````

Carlos (Oncall): pinging eng-ml. no errors in front door or rate limits. logs show model served, tokens streamed then stream closed by runtime with no exception.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: release/2026-03-15/runtime-kernel-v4 -> 10% traffic to canary at 09:12 UTC.

Jin (Eng-ML): Thanks @Carlos. That rollout timing matches customer report. two hypotheses: tokenizer normalization tweak or new attention kernel truncating when newline-normalized tokens differ. can you dump the raw token IDs for both requests?

Sam (Customer): I don\'t have tokenizer locally. attached raw request body above. customer only sees final text.

Maya (Support): @Jin any quick checks we can run from hosted logs? maybe compare token counts pre/post?

Jin (Eng-ML): pulling logs for model redwood/rw-invoice-1. quick grep: I see a change in tokenization layer where we switched to normalizing \u201c\u201d smart quotes and also a whitespace collapse flag in kernel v4. that could shift KV cache alignment for streaming.

Jin (Eng-ML): repro locally: run model with kernel-v3 vs kernel-v4 and submit the prompt with trailing newline. kernel-v3 returns full sentence; kernel-v4 stops mid-sentence after emitting 4 tokens less than expected.

Erin (Product): Is this a behavioral regression that affects other templates? do we have other customer hits?

Carlos (Oncall): Searching support for similar keywords: "truncated" + "newline" -> 3 hits in the last 2 hours, all after 09:12 UTC. one of them is internal test. suggests rollout correlated.

Jin (Eng-ML): Root cause likely changed whitespace normalization + micro change to KV cache offset handling. small prompt changes (extra newline, punctuation) change tokenization boundary and trigger a mismatch that closes generation early.

Maya (Support): Customer impact: Sam says it\'s a production flow used for billing summaries; they flagged as high priority. Sam: are you blocked entirely or can you fallback?

Sam (Customer): We can rollback our side to avoid trailing newline but it\'s brittle. prefer Redwood to fix — this breaks several templates.

Jin (Eng-ML): Next actions: 1) Rollback canary to kernel-v3 for the model fleet serving rw-invoice-1 (or route traffic off canary). 2) Add a fast regression test: prompt templates with trailing whitespace & punctuation permutations. 3) Patch kernel-v4 to preserve previous whitespace/tokenization behavior or ensure KV cache alignment.

Erin (Product): Agree. Also notify customers in the 10% canary cohort with a short note: "We are pausing canary rollout due to a prompt-sensitivity regression affecting a subset of templates."

Carlos (Oncall): Started traffic reroute: moving rw-invoice-1 off canary at 09:43 UTC. will monitor.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated: release/2026-03-15/runtime-kernel-v4 -> rollback to runtime-kernel-v3 (completed at 09:46 UTC).

Maya (Support): Sam — we rolled back the canary. can you retry your request and confirm?

Sam (Customer): Retried at 09:50 UTC, works again. thanks.

Maya (Support): Thanks for confirming. leaving escalation open until Eng-ML has a patch to prevent recurrence.

Jin (Eng-ML): Opening a ticket: ENG-ML-1129. Notes: kernel-v4 whitespace-collapse flag interacts with streaming KV offsets. repro script and token dumps attached to the ticket. plan: revert whitespace-collapse default or add a compatibility mode, unit tests for common prompt templates.

Erin (Product): Also capture this in release notes as a known compatibility change and add a checklist to canary rollout to test template-sensitive prompts.

Maya (Support): Closing loop with Sam: we\'ll follow up with ETA for fix in 48-72h, and provide a recommended quick mitigation (route around trailing whitespace or pin model to runtime-k3). Sam: any preference for notification channel?

Sam (Customer): Email is fine. thanks for fast rollback and the clear plan. Ember Systems

Maya (Support): filing outbound email + support ticket update. :thumbsup:
